intro.title: Gaurishankar Rudraksha Kantha Mala
intro.description: Gauri Shankar Mala Java is one of the rarest and one of the most powerful Rudraksha malas comprising of high quality authentic Rudraksha beads from Java, Indonesia. The Gauri Shankar Rudraksha bead is the unified form of Shiva and Shakti. The Gauri Shankar Rudraksha bead awakens the inner conscious and offers spiritual wholeness. The Gauri Shankar Rudraksha uplifts the life of the wearer in every sphere and leads it towards a positive direction: whether it be personal or professional.
